text:
As you step into the farm, you are
surrounded by lean, evil looking
pigs and a farmer wearing the
bloodied skin of a pig’s head as a
grisly mask. The man is a giant and
he is armed with a dirty pitchfork.
He asks if you have brought food
for his pigs. You may sacrifice 3
Food points, or 1 dose of Bone
powder and avoid this encounter.
Otherwise, you must fight the man
and his pigs.
Pighead, Level 5 slasher, 3 Life,
damage 2.
6 Pigs, Level 3, 2 Life each,
damage 1.
The pigs surround you. You may
try to Escape only after you have
killed at least 3 pigs. If you slay
Pighead and all the pigs, you may
further investigate the farm by
going to unique event #6.
Once you have killed Pighead,
ignore this event if it happens
again.
If you survive this encounter, you
may butcher each pig into d6 Food
points. All required ingredients
and tools are easily found in the
area.

zh-CN.title: 5 - 猪头人
text:
你走进农场，四周是一群瘦削、凶恶的猪；一个农夫戴着血淋淋的猪头皮面具，手持一把肮脏的干草叉。他身材巨大，问你有没有给他的猪带食物。你可以献出3点食物，或1剂骨粉，以避开这场遭遇。否则，你必须与他和猪群战斗。
猪头人：5级屠杀者，3点生命，伤害2。
6头猪：3级，每头2点生命，伤害1。
猪群会包围你。至少杀死3头猪后，你才能尝试逃跑。若你杀死猪头人和全部猪，可以继续调查农场，前往独特事件#6。
如果之后再次触发本事件，而猪头人已被杀死，则忽略本事件。
若你在遭遇中幸存，可以把每头猪都宰成1D6点食物。所需原料和工具在附近都能轻易找到。
